units.source_text: 酒虽然戒了，我却什么也不想做。

en.t: Although I had given up drinking, I did not feel like doing anything.

units.source_text: 没有办法，我只好又开始读书，但看不了几页，就放下了。

en.t: With nothing else to do, I began reading again, but after only a few pages I would put the book down.

units.source_text: 妻常问我为什么读书，我只能报以苦笑。

en.t: My wife often asked me why I read, and I could only answer with a bitter smile.

units.source_text: 当我想到，连这世上自己最亲近的人都不能理解自己时，便悲伤起来，

en.t: When I thought that even the person closest to me in this world could not understand me, I became sad,

units.source_text: 一想到尽管有办法使她理解自己，却又拿不出那份勇气时，就越发悲伤。

en.t: and when I thought that although there was a way to make her understand, I could not summon the courage to do it, I grew still sadder.

units.source_text: 我感到异常孤独，常常觉得只有我一个人住在这荒无人烟的世界上。

en.t: I felt unbearably lonely, and often felt as if I alone lived in this deserted world.

units.source_text: 同时，我反复思索着K的死因，

en.t: At the same time, I kept thinking over the reason for K's death,

units.source_text: 也许当时我的头脑只被一个情字所支配的关系吧，我的看法可以说是简单而直接的。

en.t: perhaps because at that time my mind was ruled by nothing but love; my view of it was simple and direct.

units.source_text: 我马上认定K是因为失恋而死。

en.t: I immediately concluded that K had died because of disappointed love.

units.source_text: 然而，当我的心情渐渐平静下来，再面对同一现象时，

en.t: However, as my feelings gradually calmed and I faced the same event again,

units.source_text: 便发觉事情并非那么简单。

en.t: I realized that the matter was not so simple.

units.source_text: 那么是由于现实与理想的冲突？

en.t: Was it, then, because of a conflict between reality and ideals?

units.source_text: 这个解释仍不足以说明问题。

en.t: That explanation was still not enough to account for it.

units.source_text: 最后我产生了这样的疑问，莫非K也和我一样，是由于孑然一身，孤独无助，才突然选择死的？

en.t: In the end, I began to wonder whether K, like me, had suddenly chosen death because he was utterly alone, lonely, and helpless.

units.source_text: 因为有种预感已经不时地像风一般掠过我的心头——我也和K一样，正走在他所走过的那条不归路上。

en.t: For a premonition had already begun to pass through my heart from time to time like the wind: I, too, like K, was walking the same road of no return that he had taken.
